correctness.rationale: For every eta>0 the noisy two-observation covariance is SPD. Exact Gram conditioning reduces risk to 1/12-v^T M^{-1}v. Symmetric-coordinate derivative factorization proves that fixing separation d leaves only centered sites or interval endpoints as candidates; the endpoint information bound is strictly smaller than two midpoint repeats. The centered derivative has a unique root d_eta in (0,1/3), and the stationary identity gives the exact minimum variance and strict noncollision. SymPy independently confirms five algebraic identities and 765 rational-grid diagnostic comparisons. Finite checks are supplementary, not the all-pairs proof.

value.rationale: The two-read budget and independent measurement noise give a motivated exact Bayesian quadrature/sensor-placement benchmark. An exact global design, strict avoidance of duplicate sites at every finite noise, and high-noise 1/(8 eta) convergence distinguish it from naive co-location or noiseless equal-thirds rules. The boundary-versus-center structural lemma is a substantive solution of a nonconvex continuous location optimization, not a mere algebraic renaming or known-table recomputation. It does not imply higher-budget, adaptive or operational speed gains.
